title: MIRO: System dump after invoice posting with PO reference
description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open transaction MIRO
2. Enter Purchase Order 4500000123
3. Enter Invoice Date and Amount
4. Click 'Post' button

Expected Result: Invoice posts successfully with reference to PO.
Actual Result: System dumps with runtime error TSV_TNEW_PAGE_ALLOC_FAILED. Short dump logged in ST22.

title: VA01: Pricing condition ZPR1 not applied for customer group Z1
description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open VA01 (Create Sales Order)
2. Enter Ship-to Party 100234 (Customer Group Z1)
3. Enter Material M-1000, Qty 10
4. Check Conditions tab

Expected Result: Pricing condition ZPR1 applied automatically.
Actual Result: ZPR1 missing, only base price PR00 shown. Total price incorrect.

title: FB50: GL posting to blocked cost center allowed without error
description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open FB50 (Post G/L Account Document)
2. Enter Company Code 1000
3. Post to GL Account 400100 with Cost Center CC-0050 (status: blocked)
4. Click Post

Expected Result: Error message — cost center is blocked, posting rejected.
Actual Result: Document posted successfully to blocked cost center CC-0050.
root_cause: Missing validation check in cost center master data authorization routine. The BAPI_COSTCENTER_GETLIST function module was not checking the 'Lock Indicator' field (LOCK_IND) before allowing postings. This was caused by a previous developer deactivating the check for a year-end special posting scenario in transport DEVK900032.
fix_description: Added explicit check for LOCK_IND field in custom validation exit Z_FI_CHECK_CC. Enhanced authorization object K_KOSTL to include locked cost center validation during document posting. Added date-based exception for year-end period (Dec 28 - Jan 5) to preserve the original business requirement.
resolution_note: Tested with 5 different blocked cost centers — all correctly rejected. Verified unblocked cost centers still post successfully. Year-end exception tested and confirmed working.

title: QE01: Inspection lot results not saved for batch-managed material
description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open QE01 (Record Results)
2. Select Inspection Lot 900000456 (Material BATCH-001, Plant 1000)
3. Enter inspection results for characteristic 'Weight' = 52.3 kg
4. Click Save

Expected Result: Results saved and usage decision enabled.
Actual Result: Error 'No inspection plan found for operation 0010'. Results not saved. Affects all batch-managed materials in plant 1000.
root_cause: Inspection plan assignment was referencing material group instead of individual material number for batch-managed materials. The custom enhancement Z_QM_INSP_PLAN used field MATKL (material group) in the WHERE clause instead of MATNR (material number) when batch management indicator XCHPF = 'X'.
fix_description: Corrected the inspection plan selection logic in custom enhancement Z_QM_INSP_PLAN to prioritize material-level plan assignment (MATNR) over material group assignment (MATKL) for batch materials where XCHPF = 'X'.
resolution_note: Fix verified in DEV environment. Batch materials BATCH-001, BATCH-002, BATCH-003 now correctly pick up inspection plans. Non-batch materials unaffected.

title: ME21N: Purchase order release strategy not triggered
description:
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open ME21N
2. Create PO over approval threshold
3. Save PO

Expected Result: Release strategy is triggered.
Actual Result: PO is saved without approval workflow.
root_cause: Custom release strategy condition table was missing the purchase organization field.
fix_description: Updated release strategy customizing and regenerated classification data.
resolution_note: Validated with three PO value ranges.

title: MIGO: Reopened goods receipt quantity mismatch
description: A previously fixed MIGO quantity conversion issue reappeared after transport import.
root_cause: Unit conversion BAdI sequence was overwritten by a transport.
fix_description: Initial correction added explicit UoM conversion fallback.
